Type: architecture diagram

Boxes/entities:
- Input
- Input Embedding
- Positional Encoding
- Dropout
- Transformer Block (Layer 1, Layer 2, Layer N)
- LayerNorm
- Linear
- Softmax
- Output
- Transformer Block Input
- LayerNorm (inside Transformer Block)
- Linear (inside Transformer Block)
- Dropout (inside Transformer Block)
- Matmul (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Mask (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Softmax (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Dropout (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Linear (inside Transformer Block, after heads)
- GELU (inside Transformer Block)
- Transformer Block Output

Connections:
- Input -> Input Embedding
- Input Embedding -> Positional Encoding
- Positional Encoding -> Dropout
- Dropout -> Transformer Block Layer 1
- Transformer Block Layer 1 -> Transformer Block Layer 2
- Transformer Block Layer 2 -> Transformer Block Layer N
- Transformer Block Layer N -> LayerNorm
- LayerNorm -> Linear
- Linear -> Softmax
- Softmax -> Output

Inside Transformer Block:
- Transformer Block Input -> LayerNorm
- LayerNorm -> Linear
- Linear -> Dropout
- Dropout -> Matmul (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Matmul (Head 1, Head 2, Head N) -> Mask (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Mask (Head 1, Head 2, Head N) -> Softmax (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Softmax (Head 1, Head 2, Head N) -> Dropout (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Dropout (Head 1, Head 2, Head N) -> Matmul (Head 1, Head 2, Head N)
- Matmul (Head 1, Head 2, Head N) -> Linear
- Linear -> Dropout
- Dropout -> LayerNorm
- LayerNorm -> Linear
- Linear -> GELU
- GELU -> Linear
- Linear -> Dropout
- Dropout -> Transformer Block Output
